## What this changes

## The landing checklist

- [ ] `spark help` has a line for it, if it is a command.
- [ ] A `spark <verb>` sets and applies it, if it is a choice: not only
      a `site.env` key.
- [ ] A `spark check` row detects it, if it is a promise the machine
      makes.
- [ ] `README.md`, `docs/INSTALL.md`, `docs/CHEATSHEET.txt` and
      `docs/CHANGELOG.md` say so.
- [ ] The gate is green locally (`AGENTS.md`, "The gate").
- [ ] The privacy notice was seen (a fork has no personal word list),
      and no personal, machine or project name was added.
- [ ] `CREDITS.md` is updated, if a pin or a model row changed.
